subject.title: Add Replicate as a delegated run provider

question: Should Crabbox accept a built-in Replicate delegated-run provider, and what runner contract, deployment/version mode, archive transport, health behavior, and prediction filtering semantics must be standardized first?
rationale: Current main lacks the provider, and the prior implementation was closed unmerged specifically because those product contracts and live proof were not accepted yet.

options.title: Keep as design record until contracts are accepted
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers settle the generic delegated-runner contract and proof requirements before another built-in Replicate PR lands.

options.title: Sponsor a new built-in provider PR now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the provider direction and ask for a fresh, narrow implementation with guarded live Replicate proof.

options.title: Defer Replicate outside core for now
options.body: Close or redirect only if maintainers decide Replicate should remain an external runner/plugin pattern rather than a built-in provider.

recommendation.title: Keep as design record until contracts are accepted
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers settle the generic delegated-runner contract and proof requirements before another built-in Replicate PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They closed the prior implementation while preserving this issue as the canonical product-design record and authored the current lifecycle/proof guardrails.
